Register followup: build-config.test.ts REQ-PPH-04.1 runs a raw unmemoized `bun run build` against the real dist/ (rm -rf + rebuild). PRE-EXISTING, but this change widened its window from a 2-step to a 3-step build. One unreproduced full-suite failure was observed at S-000 (1 fail once, then 2191/0 across six runs, plus 2196/0 across four more at S-001). NARROWED 2026-07-25 — TWO occurrences, BOTH identities LOST (tailed instead of captured; the second loss was the executor's, self-reported). RULED OUT with evidence: (a) cross-file race — bun `--parallel` is opt-in (1.3.14), no bunfig.toml, and both package.json#scripts.test and .github/workflows/ci.yml run plain `bun test`, so test FILES are sequential; (b) varying file order — test-file ordering is deterministic (identical md5 of the emitted file sequence across three captured runs). NOT RULED OUT: (i) transient IO/resource failure during PPH-04.1's real rebuild; (ii) CONCURRENT `bun test` runs in the same worktree from different agents — PPH-04.1's `rm -rf dist` in one process poisons any other process reading the real dist/. OPERATIONAL RULE adopted: never run the suite concurrently in this worktree, and always capture full output to a file before re-running. Fix direction: isolate PPH-04.1 to a scratch root.

problem_statement: The engine must verify the integrity of the real pbuilder-runner.js before exec'ing code it does not own. The runner is thin and multi-file, so neither digest-pinning nor a bundle hash applies; it needs a manifest of the runner's static import closure, which only the SDK can produce.
